# vendor/mermaid-prism · licenses

This folder is a **build artifact**, not source. It is a self-contained ES-module build of
[mermaid-prism](https://github.com/duzafizzl/mermaid-prism) (MIT © 2026 Clarissa Röthig,
see `LICENSE-mermaid-prism.txt`) so the static Atlas can import it on GitHub Pages without a bundler.

- Built from mermaid-prism commit `bb08adb` (clean `git archive HEAD` export, no working-tree WIP).
- Vite 8 library build, ESM, minified, no source maps. `mermaid-prism.js` = entry (public API + `parseMermaid` + lazy `renderDrill3d`); `chunks/` = lazy chunks
  (three.js / 3D renderer and Mermaid diagram types load only when used); `prism.css` = themes + player bar.
- Every third-party package is included **unmodified**.

## Packages that ship in this bundle

| Package | Version | License | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [mermaid](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid) | 12.2.0 | MIT | Parser + stock-Mermaid fallback renderer |
| [elkjs](https://github.com/kieler/elkjs) | 0.12.0 | EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later | **Used under EPL-2.0**, unmodified. Graph layout. Source: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs (Eclipse Layout Kernel https://github.com/eclipse/elk). License text: https://www.eclipse.org/legal/epl-2.0/ |
| elkjs (via mermaid) | 0.9.3 | EPL-2.0 | Mermaid's own copy for its ELK layout option; same terms |
| [three](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) | 0.186.1 | MIT | 3D mode only (lazy chunk `chunks/stage-*.js`) |
| [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) | 3.4.17 | MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 | Via mermaid. **Used under Apache-2.0**, unmodified |

Full transitive list (from mermaid-prism `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, generated by its `scripts/license-audit.mjs`).
`@types/*` packages are type-only and contain no runtime code in this bundle.
